product.olivetti-m4-pxx-i.summary: The M4-Pxx i branch adopted an Atlantis board with onboard ATI graphics.
product.olivetti-m4-pxx-i.history: Olivetti identified the Atlantis BA2267 branch as M4-Pxx i. Intel’s Advanced/AS specification documents the same CL0 BIOS family.
product.olivetti-m4-pxx-i.architecture: Video is on the motherboard. The BA2267 integrates ATI Mach64-CT and reserves the CELP socket with 256 KB of L2 cache for 133 and 166 MHz configurations.
product.olivetti-m4-pxx-i.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m4-pxx-i.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m4-pxx-i.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 17
product.olivetti-m4-pxx-i.intel-advanced: Intel, Advanced/AS Technical Product Specification, order 281836-001
product.olivetti-m4-pxx-i.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 1.00.04.CL0.
